# Independent document conformance fixtures

`standard.json` and `legacy.json` are generated by the shipped Rust server's
`describe` command. Legacy omits optional MCP outputSchema while preserving an
explicit Gateway result contract. They are compared against executable exports.

`variations.json` is the negative conformance matrix; `peer.py` is an independent
stdio peer injecting each listed fault at the named protocol stage. These are
controlled fixtures, not live provider/security certification. `github-peer.py`
replaces only HTTPS in the shipped GitHub adapter with a GitHub file envelope.
No secret is required or retained. See `docs/independent-reference-connector.md`.
